claims: The U.S. Virgin Islands includes St. Thomas, St. John, and St. Croix.
Trunk Bay is on St. John.
Magens Bay is on St. Thomas.
Buck Island Reef National Monument is on St. Croix.
Charlotte Amalie is the capital.
Water Lemon Cay is a snorkeling and diving location.
Reef Bay Trail is a hiking trail.
Annaberg Sugar Plantation has ruins.
Fort Christian is a historic site.
St. Thomas has duty-free shopping.
St. Thomas has a harbor.
Over half of St. John is protected as a National Park.
St. Croix is the largest island.
Christiansted is a historic town on St. Croix.
Frederiksted is a historic town on St. Croix.
Water Island is the smallest island.
The population of the U.S. Virgin Islands is approximately 87,000.
The U.S. Virgin Islands has an average temperature of 77°F in winter.
The U.S. Virgin Islands has an average temperature of 82°F in summer.
The U.S. Virgin Islands has the highest rainfall from June to November.
The U.S. Virgin Islands is a U.S. Territory.
U.S. citizens can visit the U.S. Virgin Islands without a passport.
Others need a passport to visit the U.S. Virgin Islands.
Driving in the U.S. Virgin Islands is on the left side of the road.
